title: An innovative electrochemical sensor for brinzolamide detection in athletes' urine using a mercury–phen complex: a step forward in anti-doping
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34214-34227
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06591C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Noha G. Abdel-Hafez, Marwa F. B. Ali, Noha N. Atia, Samia M. El-Gizawy
In this study, the electrochemical behavior of brinzolamide (BRZ), an antiglaucoma drug, was studied for the first time using a carbon paste electrode modified with a mercuric chloride–1,10-phenanthroline complex (HgCl2–Phen complex).
